description: Independent paper-first models. Excel values and ordering are immutable.

provenance.inputs: InputData.xlsx values and row order are used verbatim: no scale, exponent, offset, time shift, smoothing or reconstructed input substitution.
provenance.2025_reference: Nie et al., Nuclear Engineering and Design 440 (2025) 114138, Table 5, p12.
provenance.2024_reference: Nie et al., Applied Thermal Engineering 248 (2024) 123365, Tables 7-9, pp12-13. Table 5 is algorithm performance, NOT system DPSP/LCOE.
provenance.reactor: 2025 main text p7 fixes 25 MWth; appendix A2 says 50 MWth. Both discrete interpretations are screened, not a freely fitted reactor. 2024 always uses its published 50 MWth / 20 MWe.
provenance.PV: Equation area/efficiency implies 189.44 W at STC whereas appendix lists 150 W. Nameplate normalization is an explicit conflicting-specification hypothesis, not a confirmed formula correction.
provenance.TES: No numerical TES ratings are supplied. Test absolute MWth and ratings proportional to C_TES/2000. Initial/minimum 5%, unit efficiencies and zero losses stay fixed.
provenance.inactive_soec: keep_split retains DF allocations when SOEC is ineligible. renewables_first tests redispatch only when hydrogen cannot operate; this alternative is not verified author control.
provenance.soc_switch: start tests the stated condition at interval start. post_guard additionally rejects a hydrogen-mode allocation that would end below TES factor; an explicitly unverified within-interval interpretation.
provenance.hydrogen: Valid candidates obey both 35.1 kWhe/kg and 11.15 kWhth/kg requirements, using the smaller resource-limited quantity described in text. The contradictory additive Eq9 is a separate invalid-resource diagnostic, never selected.
provenance.finance: Rates, project horizon, cost units, E_load meaning and decommissioning conventions are not all identified. Published unit prices are fixed. Replacement is strictly before project end; no salvage.
provenance.balance_of_plant: embedded treats reactor OCC as encompassing PB and omits separately unidentified inverter sizing. separate_rated_proxy adds Table A3 turbine/compressor at reactor net electrical rating, HX at reactor thermal rating and inverter at max(PV nameplate, battery rating). These are sizing proxies, not an identified plant design; may double-count items embedded in OCC.
provenance.2024_inputs: 2024 scales source load by 550, versus 1000 in 2025. Supplied Excel max demand 15 MW is below the 2024 reactor's 20 MWe: literal unchanged-input DPSP must be zero. Do not count that as successful reproduction.
provenance.algorithm_table: 2024 Table5 HV and convergence statistics require the four repeated MOEA experiments and comparable normalization/reference points. This grid search does not reproduce those statistics.
provenance.scope: All published capacities, DF, TES factors, efficiencies, component prices and input values fixed. No RL or mode-specific fitted assumptions.
